content.name: [VAS] Turret Behavior Menu (Resurrected)
content.description: Resurrected port of Berserk Knight's Turret Behavior Menu. Adds turret behavior options (arm/disarm, attack enemies / capitals / fighters, defend, mining, missile defence, auto-assist) to the right-click menu — per turret size and per turret type, for the player ship, selected ships and player-owned stations. Rebuilt on top of kuertee UI Extensions instead of the original RightClickAPI / G_Work_Around dependencies. All credit for the original design goes to Berserk Knight.
content.author: VasiliyTemniy
